response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_qty AS average_quantity, inv.cost_ratio, inv.avg_qty - overall.overall_avg AS difference_above_overall FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE inv.avg_qty > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY difference_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10
